_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior aluminum siding repaint. Context prefix ALRP (ALuminum RePaint) — no collision with existing prefixes (VNRP is vinyl repaint, WSRP is wood siding repaint). Key differences from vinyl sibling: TWO substrate states (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT + SS_EXT_CHALKING), chalk_severity configuration dimension (replaces lrv_class), self-etching primer chemistry (NOT STIX adhesion — phosphoric acid + zinc), DFT-critical primer (0.5-1.0 mil max), oxide scuff task, coastal epoxy intermediate layer, NO LRV restriction. QT2-QT3 only — aluminum siding is not a fine-finish substrate.

paintable_items.name: Exterior siding field surface
paintable_items.notes: REUSED from SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT, SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC, and SF_SIDING_VINYL_EXT_RP. Same physical item (siding field), aluminum repaint context. Add SF_SIDING_ALUMINUM_EXT_RP to used_in array.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, VNRP. ALRP is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_ALRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_ALRP_WASH_PRESSURE, TSK_ALRP_CHALK_VERIFY, TSK_ALRP_SCUFF_OXIDE, TSK_ALRP_PRIME_ETCH_SPRAY, TSK_ALRP_PRIME_EPOXY_SPRAY, TSK_ALRP_FINISH_SPRAY_1, TSK_ALRP_DETAIL_BRUSH, TSK_ALRP_DFT_VERIFY, TSK_ALRP_MASK_WINDOWS

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — landscape, hardscape, HVAC, light fixtures, window/door masking (spray method). No warranty void gate (aluminum siding warranties have typically expired). No LRV verification gate (aluminum has no LRV restriction).

Protection zone setup for spray/brush_roll operations. Includes window masking, door masking, trim masking, roofline masking, landscape/hardscape protection. Method-dependent escalation (spray requires more coverage).

Pressure wash — mandatory first production step. Alkaline cleaner (TSP or siding cleaner), downward spray pattern, 500-1000 PSI. chalk_severity drives wash intensity: none = standard wash; light = TSP + chalk removal verification; heavy = multiple passes + mechanical scrubbing + extended dwell time. 24-48 hour dry time before scuffing/priming.

Surface preparation — chalk verification gate (mandatory pass before scuff/prime, all chalk_severity levels), oxide layer scuff (180-320 grit abrasive pads to break Al2O3 film). TIMING CRITICAL: prime within 4-8 hours of scuff (2-4 hours coastal). PCA P14 Level 2.

Self-etching primer (phosphoric acid + zinc) spray application. Single coat. DFT 0.5-1.0 mil MAXIMUM — over-application causes cohesive failure. Fine-atomization spray tip. Single-pass technique. ALWAYS required regardless of substrate state. NOT the same as STIX adhesion primer (vinyl) — completely different chemistry.

Epoxy primer intermediate coat. COASTAL ONLY — conditional on site environment (salt air exposure). Applied between self-etching primer and acrylic topcoat. Creates three-layer corrosion barrier system. Per manufacturer spec for DFT and inter-coat timing.

Finish coat application — 100% acrylic latex exterior, spray. QT2 = single finish coat. QT3 = two finish coats. NO backbrushing — aluminum is non-porous metal. No LRV-class material branching (any color permitted on aluminum).
Brush detail at J-channels, under-sill channels, corner transitions, and trim cut-in. QT3 only — primary labor differentiator between tiers. Rate: 125-175 SF/hr. Same as vinyl detail module.

Protection teardown, site cleanup, tool cleaning. No RRP waste disposal (aluminum siding factory enamel is not lead-based). Includes caulk assessment and replacement at siding-to-trim joints (QT3 only).

quality_tier.notes: QT4/QT5 excluded — aluminum siding is not a fine-finish substrate. QT2 = economy (wash, self-etching prime, single finish coat). QT3 = standard (TSP wash with chalk verification, self-etching prime, two finish coats, J-channel detail, caulk assessment). Per KD-004.

application_method.notes: Spray is primary method for aluminum siding field. NO backbrushing — aluminum is non-porous metal, coating does not absorb. Brush_roll for detail areas or when spray is not feasible. Per KD-010.

chalk_severity.notes: NEW enum type — unique to aluminum siding repaint. Drives PREP LABOR TIME, not primer chemistry. none = standard wash; light = TSP wash + chalk verification; heavy = multiple wash passes + mechanical scrubbing + extended dwell + mandatory re-verification. Replaces lrv_class from vinyl (aluminum has no LRV restriction). Per KD-003.

sheen.notes: Standard exterior sheens for aluminum siding. Satin is most common default. Semi-gloss available (no LRV restriction, no thermal concern). More sheen options than vinyl (which excludes semi-gloss on siding field).

phase.notes: No 'interstage' phase — aluminum does not require intercoat sanding on non-porous metal surface. No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF is primary UOM for siding field tasks. LF for caulk work and trim masking. EA for protection items and per-project tasks. FIXED for tool cleaning and administrative gates.

substrate_state.notes: TWO input states (vs vinyl's one). SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT: existing coating adhered, minimal chalk, prep modifier 1.10x. SS_EXT_CHALKING: existing coating chalky but adhered, prep modifier 1.40x. Both states are repaintable. Both require self-etching primer (chemistry does not change). State drives prep labor time. Output state varies by sheen selection. All states are existing in controlled_enums.json.

product_role.notes: Primer (self-etching) and finish (100% acrylic). Specialty for epoxy intermediate coat (coastal conditional). No sealer/clear/stain needed.

protection_level.notes: Repaint on occupied homes — spray method requires full_cover/full_mask on windows, doors, and adjacent trim. Same protection structure as vinyl repaint.

condition_scale.notes: Universal condition scale mapped from chalk_severity. GOOD=none(1.0x), FAIR=light(1.5x), POOR=heavy(2.0x).

surface_ids.notes: All surface IDs exist in id_registry.json. Primary surface and all adjacent surfaces are in active use. Research references 'fascia' — resolved to ext_trim_frieze which covers the frieze/fascia junction zone. Identical adjacency pattern to vinyl siding repaint.

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD — NC standard 100% acrylic exterior finish. Same binder class for topcoat, but aluminum requires distinct self-etching primer (not wood-compatible primers).
SYS_PRIMER_BONDING — NC bonding primer for smooth substrates. NOT suitable for aluminum — bonding primers do not address Al2O3 oxide layer. Self-etching chemistry required.
SYS_VNRP_PRIMER_ADHESION — Vinyl STIX-class adhesion primer. NOT suitable for aluminum — STIX is designed for PVC solvent attack, not metal oxide etching.

proposed_systems.name: Self-Etching Primer (Phosphoric Acid + Zinc)
proposed_systems.notes: ALWAYS required for aluminum siding. Self-etching primer containing phosphoric acid (etches Al2O3 oxide layer) and zinc (galvanic corrosion resistance). Products: Rust-Oleum Self-Etching Primer, Sherwin-Williams Wash Primer, PPG DP Series. DFT 0.5-1.0 mil ONLY — over-application causes cohesive failure. Single coat, full coverage spray with fine-atomization tip. Coverage: 400-500 SF/gal (thin film application). FUNDAMENTALLY different from vinyl adhesion primer (STIX) — different chemistry, different mechanism, different substrate target.

proposed_systems.name: Epoxy Primer Intermediate Coat (Coastal Only)
proposed_systems.notes: COASTAL CONDITIONAL — only when site assessment indicates salt-air exposure. Applied between self-etching primer and acrylic topcoat. Creates three-layer corrosion barrier: self-etch -> epoxy -> acrylic. Provides chemical-resistant barrier against salt penetration. Coverage: per manufacturer spec. Must verify inter-coat compatibility with self-etching primer below and acrylic topcoat above.

proposed_systems.name: 100% Acrylic Latex Exterior Finish
proposed_systems.notes: Standard finish for aluminum siding repaint. 100% acrylic latex exterior — recommended for durability and flexibility on metal. NO LRV restriction — any color permitted (aluminum conducts heat, no warping risk). QT2 = economy grade, single coat. QT3 = mid-grade, two coats. Coverage: 350-450 SF/gal. No LRV-class material branching (simpler than vinyl which needs standard vs IR-reflective).

material_system_prefix.notes: 3 material systems: 1 mandatory self-etching primer + 1 conditional epoxy intermediate + 1 finish. SIMPLER material path than vinyl (no LRV-class branching on finish). MORE complex primer path (self-etching chemistry vs single adhesion primer). Binder for topcoat is 100% acrylic recommended but not LOCKED like vinyl (alkyd finish over self-etch primer is acceptable but uncommon residential).

proposed_consumables.name: Fine-Atomization Airless Spray Tip (Self-Etching Primer)
proposed_consumables.notes: Fine-atomization tip for thin-film self-etching primer application. Critical for 0.5-1.0 mil DFT control. Different from standard 517 tip used for latex topcoat.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 517 (Finish Coat)
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard tip for acrylic latex finish coat spray on aluminum siding.

proposed_consumables.name: 180-320 Grit Abrasive Pad (Oxide Scuff)
proposed_consumables.notes: Synthetic steel wool or abrasive pad for breaking Al2O3 oxide layer. More aggressive than vinyl scuff pads. 180-320 grit range.

proposed_consumables.name: Roller Cover 3/8 inch Nap (Brush_Roll Method)
proposed_consumables.notes: For brush_roll application method. 3/8 inch nap for smooth metal surface.

proposed_consumables.name: Masking Paper 12 inch Roll (Window/Door Masking)
proposed_consumables.notes: For window and door masking during spray operations.

proposed_consumables.name: Plastic Sheeting for Exterior Protection
proposed_consumables.notes: Landscape/hardscape/HVAC overspray protection. Also used for wash runoff containment (chalk removal chemistry may stain hardscape).

proposed_consumables.name: Siliconized Acrylic Paintable Caulk
proposed_consumables.notes: For siding-to-trim joint caulk replacement (QT3 only). Siliconized acrylic — aluminum has minimal thermal movement at joints.

proposed_consumables.name: 60-Mesh Spray Filter (Black) for Latex
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard 60-mesh filter for latex coatings through airless equipment.

proposed_consumables.name: Red Stucco Poly Tape (7 mil, 30-day UV)
proposed_consumables.notes: For extended spray masking on exterior. Higher adhesion than blue tape on smooth surfaces.

proposed_consumables.name: TSP or Alkaline Siding Cleaner
proposed_consumables.notes: For pressure wash chalk removal. TSP (trisodium phosphate) or dedicated aluminum siding cleaner. Bulk quantity for heavy chalk projects.

proposed_consumables.name: Wet/Dry Film Thickness Gauge
proposed_consumables.notes: For DFT verification during and after self-etching primer application. Critical QC tool — 0.5-1.0 mil DFT range must be verified.

proposed_configurations.description: Self-etching prime (1 coat, 0.5-1.0 mil) + 1 finish coat — economy aluminum repaint
proposed_configurations.notes: Minimum viable aluminum repaint. Self-etching primer is mandatory (not optional). Single finish coat. Total: 2 coating passes.

proposed_configurations.description: Self-etching prime (1 coat, 0.5-1.0 mil) + 2 finish coats — standard aluminum repaint
proposed_configurations.notes: Standard residential repaint. Self-etching primer + two finish coats for better DFT and durability. J-channel detail coat included. Total: 3 coating passes + detail.

proposed_configurations.description: Self-etching prime (1 coat) + epoxy intermediate (1 coat) + 1 finish coat — coastal economy
proposed_configurations.notes: Coastal variant adds epoxy intermediate between primer and finish. Total: 3 coating passes.

proposed_configurations.description: Self-etching prime (1 coat) + epoxy intermediate (1 coat) + 2 finish coats — coastal standard
proposed_configurations.notes: Coastal variant with full coat system. Total: 4 coating passes + detail.

proposed_profiles.description: Self-etching primer on aluminum — 400-500 SF/gal. Thin film application (0.5-1.0 mil DFT). Higher coverage than standard primers due to thin-film requirement. Over-application = cohesive failure.
Epoxy intermediate coat on primed aluminum — per manufacturer spec. Coastal only.
100% acrylic latex finish on primed aluminum — 350-450 SF/gal per coat. Good coverage on smooth non-porous metal surface.

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Window/door protection during siding spray is this spec's responsibility when those surfaces do not have their own active spec. Trim, soffit, and fascia are separate spec scopes. No cross-spec flags needed. No RRP gate (aluminum siding factory enamel is not lead-based). No LRV gate (aluminum has no LRV restriction). Coastal environment is a site-level condition assessed per project.

existing_modifiers: FAC_EXT_ACCESS — ground=1.00, ladder=1.35, scaffold=1.60, lift=1.50 (existing, shared across exterior specs)

proposed_modifiers.applies_to: qt_scaled tasks only. QT2 = economy (less care, single finish coat, minimal J-channel detail). QT3 = baseline standard.
proposed_modifiers.notes: Standard QT modifier pattern. No QT4/QT5 — aluminum is not a fine-finish substrate.

proposed_modifiers.description: Chalk severity rate modifier — prep/wash tasks only
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: Prep and wash tasks ONLY. Does not affect prime, finish, or detail tasks. Chalk severity changes wash/prep labor intensity, not coating application labor.
proposed_modifiers.notes: NEW modifier unique to aluminum siding repaint. Replaces lrv_class from vinyl (which affects material selection, not labor). Chalk removal is the dominant prep cost variable for aluminum siding. Heavy chalk (1.75x) reflects multiple wash passes, mechanical scrubbing, extended dwell time, and mandatory re-verification. Stacks with substrate_state prep modifier (SS_EXT_CHALKING = 1.40x on base prep tasks).

factor_modifiers.notes: 3 modifiers total: FAC_EXT_ACCESS (existing, shared) + FAC_ALRP_QT (proposed, standard pattern) + FAC_ALRP_CHALK (proposed, aluminum-specific). No DSD modifier (aluminum has no deterioration gradient like wood). No RRP modifier (factory enamel is not lead-based). No siding_profile modifier (aluminum siding is uniform lap profile). Simpler than wood siding repaint (4+ modifiers) but MORE complex than vinyl repaint (2 modifiers) due to chalk_severity dimension.

materials_json.aluminum_specific: Self-etching primer (phosphoric acid + zinc) is MANDATORY — STIX-class adhesion primers and standard bonding primers do NOT work on aluminum oxide. DFT 0.5-1.0 mil ONLY on self-etching primer. Acrylic finish recommended but not binder-locked like vinyl. Epoxy intermediate for coastal environments — verify system compatibility across all three layers.

sop_modules_json.aluminum_specific: Include CHALK VERIFICATION GATE as mandatory pass before scuff/prime. Include DFT VERIFICATION task during/after self-etching primer application. Enforce same-day SCUFF-TO-PRIME sequencing (oxide reformation concern). NO warranty void gate, NO LRV gate (unlike vinyl).

production_json.aluminum_specific: 3 multiplicative modifiers: FAC_EXT_ACCESS + FAC_ALRP_QT + FAC_ALRP_CHALK (chalk on prep tasks only). Substrate state modifier stacks with chalk_severity on wash tasks. Self-etching primer rate (350-450 SF/hr) is DISTINCT from vinyl adhesion primer rate. Oxide scuff task (200-300 SF/hr) is unique to aluminum — no equivalent in vinyl.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → prime → finish → cleanup (no interstage for aluminum)
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_ALRP_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_SIDING_FIELD MUST be used exactly as registered (existing ID)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

RULE 12 (ALUMINUM-SPECIFIC): Self-etching primer is ALWAYS required — no conditional logic, no spot prime option. Every variant includes prime module. Primer chemistry does NOT change by substrate state.
RULE 13 (ALUMINUM-SPECIFIC): chalk_severity drives PREP LABOR TIME only, NOT primer chemistry or material selection. All chalk severity paths converge at complete removal.

RULE 14 (ALUMINUM-SPECIFIC): DFT for self-etching primer is 0.5-1.0 mil MAXIMUM. Over-application causes cohesive failure within primer film. This is a CRITICAL application parameter that must be documented in SOP and QC tasks.
RULE 15 (ALUMINUM-SPECIFIC): Coastal environment triggers epoxy intermediate layer (SYS_EXT_ALRP_PRIMER_EPOXY). This is a CONDITIONAL module — include applies_when for coastal flag.
RULE 16 (ALUMINUM-SPECIFIC): No LRV restriction, no LRV gate, no IR-reflective product requirement. Any color permitted. Do NOT include lrv_class in any dimension, variant, or material path.
RULE 17 (ALUMINUM-SPECIFIC): Oxide scuff and self-etching prime MUST be scheduled same-day in SOP. Include timing note on scuff task (4-8 hr window, 2-4 hr coastal).

Distinct from vinyl repaint (different primer chemistry — self-etching vs STIX adhesion, different substrate states — 2 vs 1, chalk_severity dimension, no LRV restriction, coastal epoxy layer). Distinct from wood siding repaint (no DSD gradient, no RRP, simpler deterioration model).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Self-Etching Primer (Phosphoric Acid + Zinc)

STIX adhesion primers (vinyl) and bonding primers (smooth substrates) are completely different products targeting different substrates. Phosphoric acid + zinc formulation addresses Al2O3 oxide layer specifically.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Epoxy Primer Intermediate Coat (Coastal)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW — coastal-conditional epoxy intermediate layer. No existing system covers this role. Creates corrosion barrier between self-etching primer and acrylic topcoat in salt-air environments.

No LRV-class split needed (any color permitted). Coverage rate tracking on aluminum surface. Single finish system (simpler than vinyl's 2-system LRV split).

registry_additions_proposed.justification: Coverage profile for self-etching primer on aluminum — 400-500 SF/gal. Thin film application, different coverage from standard primers.
